headlines.title: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeats Karen Bass in the L.A. mayor’s race
headlines.description: City Council member Nithya Raman has defeated incumbent Karen Bass in the Los Angeles mayoral race, NBC News projects, capping off a rapid political ascent for a progressive challenger who railed against the “broken status quo” in the country’s second-largest metropolis.

headlines.title: Melania Trump on Oleshky ceasefire: Russia and Ukraine have chosen 'humanity over war'
headlines.description: First lady Melania Trump hosted delegations from Russia and Ukraine to highlight the humanitarian ceasefire she helped broker in Oleshky. She praised the countries for choosing "humanity over war" by following through with the agreement.

headlines.title: How Democratic control in Congress affects the future of judicial appointees
headlines.description: President Donald Trump cemented the U.S. Supreme Court’s conservative majority through three appointments. NBC News’ Lawrence Hurley details what Democratic control of the Senate means for the judicial appointees the president can make.

headlines.title: New Contenders Emerge in Both Parties in Race for 2028
headlines.description: With the midterms in the rearview, the march toward 2028 is quickly coming into focus. Presidential speculation is already percolating about some Democrats who helped drive the midterm victories and some Republicans who are already positioning themselves as the one who can lead their party back to the White House. NBC’s Hallie Jackson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Photos: Celebration and gloom at watch parties across the U.S.
headlines.description: Joy and despair punctuated election watch parties overnight after a blue tsunami swept the country’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna allies launch a draft campaign for the 2028 presidential race
headlines.description: Exclusive: The California congressman has been traveling the country and building prominence among progressives.

headlines.title: ‘A Watergate-level repudiation’: Ted Cruz weighs in on midterm wave
headlines.description: Sen. Ted Cruz, R-Texas, urged his party to prioritize pocketbook issues after Democrats swept elections across the state.

headlines.title: Billionaire Leon Black sues congressman, alleging defamation over Epstein comments
headlines.description: Garcia is poised to be the next chair of the House Oversight Committee, which has subpoenaed Black as part of its investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.

headlines.title: 5 healthcare fights Democrats could take on after midterms sweep
headlines.description: Democrats will have leverage to try to restore the expired Obamacare tax credits, reverse Medicaid cuts and push for changes they say would make healthcare more affordable.

headlines.title: Mississippi Senate race heads to an extended vote count and possible ballot battle
headlines.description: The Mississippi Senate race may take days to resolve, as Democrat Scott Colom leads GOP Sen.
